news.title: BuildSurvival prepares for complete rework
news.article: (LEGiON Platforms) - LEGiON Platforms is excited to announce that BuildSurvival, its popular 3D building game, is being reworked for an improved gaming experience. The reworked version will feature enhanced graphics, new building materials and tools, and improved building mechanics. The game will also include new multiplayer modes, allowing players to build and survive with friends. LEGiON Platforms is looking forward to releasing the reworked version of BuildSurvival and can't wait for players to experience the new features and improvements.
